topic: Ordering Coffee at a Busy Café

script.title: ORDERING COFFEE AT A BUSY CAFÉ
script.story_hook: Ordering coffee at a packed café with a long line.
script.intro_zh: 在客滿、排隊很長的咖啡店點咖啡。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, welcome back! Today we're ordering coffee at a busy café.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們要在一家忙碌的咖啡店點咖啡。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young East Asian woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a cream knit sweater and a light trench coat, holding a canvas tote bag
script.char_b_description: a friendly man in his early thirties with short curly black hair and a neat beard, wearing a dark green barista apron over a white shirt and a black cap
script.youtube_title: 【☕點咖啡實戰英文】「冰塊少一點」怎麼說？超實用咖啡店句型，聽完就能開口｜Busy Café English

Join Mei at a packed coffee shop as she customizes a drink, gives her name, pays with mobile, and picks up her order — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and start speaking today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】☕點咖啡英文｜客製飲品・報上名字・手機支付｜聽完就會點餐｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
出國卻不敢開口點咖啡？
人很多、又要客製化，到底該怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進一家尖峰時刻擠滿人的咖啡店，跟著 Mei 從點單、客製飲品、報上名字，到手機支付與取餐，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
☕ 點飲品與客製化：例如「a large oat milk latte」、「go easy on the ice」。
🏷️ 報名字與取餐：例如「Can I get a name for the cup?」、「I'll call your name」。
📱 付費與找座位：例如「Do you take mobile pay or just cards?」、「Where can I wait for it?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來點杯咖啡可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a latte cup with a name tag

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can I get a large oat milk latte?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə lɑrdʒ oʊt mɪlk ˈlæteɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我可以點一杯大杯的燕麥奶拿鐵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！今天要熱的還是冰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iced, please. And could you go easy on the ice?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪst pliːz ənd kʊd ju ɡoʊ ˈizi ɑn ði aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 冰的，謝謝。可以冰塊少一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Anything else for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually yes, what do you recommend with vanilla?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli jɛs wʌt du ju ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd wɪð vəˈnɪlə/
dialogue.zh: 其實要的，加香草的話你們推薦什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The vanilla iced latte is a fan favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə vəˈnɪlə aɪst ˈlæteɪ ɪz ə fæn ˈfeɪvərɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll try that one instead then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl traɪ ðæt wʌn ɪnˈstɛd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我改要那一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. Can I get a name for the cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt tʃɔɪs kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə neɪm fɔr ðə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。請問杯子上要寫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Mei. That'll be five fifty, ready soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks meɪ ðætəl bi faɪv ˈfɪfti ˈridi sun/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝 Mei。共五塊五，馬上好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take mobile pay or just cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk ˈmoʊbəl peɪ ɔr dʒʌst kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 你們收手機支付還是只收卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both work here, tap or scan, whatever's easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ wɜrk hɪr tæp ɔr skæn wətˈɛvərz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 兩種都行，感應或掃描，怎麼方便怎麼來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I'll tap. Where can I wait for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪl tæp wɛr kæn aɪ weɪt fɔr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我用感應的。我可以在哪裡等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a counter up front; I'll call your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə ˈkaʊntər ʌp frʌnt aɪl kɔl jɔr neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 前面有取餐台，我會叫你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good, thanks for your help this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd θæŋks fɔr jɔr hɛlp ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯，謝謝你早上的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure! Here's your iced vanilla latte, Mei.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər hɪrz jɔr aɪst vəˈnɪlə ˈlæteɪ meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！Mei，這是你的香草冰拿鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast! You guys are amazing on a rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz fæst ju ɡaɪz ɑr əˈmeɪz ɑn ə rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好快！你們在高峰時段太厲害了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try! Have a great rest of your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ hæv ə ɡreɪt rɛst əv jɔr deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們盡力啦！祝你今天接下來愉快。
